config.title: Speech Settings
config.keyfile: Archivo de Google Cloud Speech Key
config.speech dev help:
Para obtener ayuda, consulte los documentos.
Además, estamos disponibles en Discord Chat con para ayudarlo en tiempo real.
config.sensitivity help: Muévase sobre la barra para ver el valor aquí.
config.audio gain help: Use 1.0 for normal mics. Values above 1.0 amplify audio and increase false hotwords.
config.hotword cooldown help: Minimum time between accepted hotwords before voice reco streaming can start again.
config.empty final backoff help: After voice reco returns an empty transcript (likely a false hotword), wait this long before accepting another hotword.
config.resource file help: Leave blank to use the classic sonus resources/common.res. Only set this if you need a specific Snowboy resource file path.
